items.title: Byte Debt (CVE-2026-102479): From an HTTP Header Typo to Cross-User Session Fixation
items.summary: A one-letter typo, Content-Xength, is accepted as Content-Length by the Eclipse Vert.x HTTP/1.x decoder (CVE-2026-102479). We chain it into response-queue desync and cross-user session fixation behind real reverse proxies.

items.title: The Impact of AI on CVEs: Industry Challenges
items.summary: Integrating artificial intelligence into cybersecurity has fundamentally changed vulnerability research - and not necessarily for the better. items.summary: JFrog Security Research linked 42 armed GitHub repositories in the testmetest campaign to a hidden npm publisher, an active encrypted data sink and previously reported GitHub Actions cPanel exploitation infrastructure.

items.title: Brotli2Shell: Beyond Node(2Shell) and HTTP(2Shell)
items.summary: CVE-2026-111497 ("Brotli2Shell") is an out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder that reaches far beyond Node.js and HTTP. JFrog Security Research reproduced a remote crash in ClickHouse, native memory corruption in FFmpeg through JPEG XL, a .NET runtime crash, and an infinite loop in Apache Arrow, and released an open-source scanner that finds Brotli decoding paths version-only scanners miss.
